title: New Jersey drone flap and objects emerging from the water
summary: Jesse Michels tells of New Jersey drone flap and objects emerging from the water, about 2024 at New Jersey coast, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And it seemed to be implying that, you know, he thinks that they're coming from underwater. And there were sightings of course around that time [clears throat] off the coast where it seemed like these UAPs were emerging from the water.

related.note: Same 2024 New Jersey drone flap, but this telling claims the objects come from underwater, emerging off the coast.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the wave of mystery drone sightings over New Jersey in 2024, citing a Rolling Stone article, a man named Greg Scaduto, and comments from President Donald Trump. Michels says the remarks seemed to imply the objects were coming from underwater, and that around that time there were sightings off the coast where UAPs, the government's term for unidentified objects, seemed to be coming up out of the water. If true, it would point to something hiding in the ocean.
